acceptanceCriteria.criterion: First-time setup wizard appears automatically when settingsStore.isFirstRun is true (no settings_root row exists). Wizard is shown before any authenticated content and cannot be bypassed.
Wizard Welcome screen presents two large cards: "Explore with Sample Data" (prominent, recommended badge) and "Start Fresh with Real Data" (disabled with "Coming in future update" note).

Selecting "Explore with Sample Data" triggers client-side seeding that creates: Katete Model Village configuration, 2-3 sample council members, 5-6 households (mixed types), 15-20 residents with realistic names and relationships.
After successful seeding, village_settings.is_using_sample_data is set to true and user is redirected to dashboard.

Persistent banner displays on all authenticated pages when isUsingSampleData is true: yellow background, "🏷️ SAMPLE DATA MODE - Exploring Katete Model Village" text, and "Start Fresh - Wipe All Data" button. Banner is not dismissible.
Clicking "Start Fresh - Wipe All Data" opens confirmation dialog requiring user to type "DELETE EVERYTHING" exactly to enable the confirm button.

Confirmed wipe triggers Appwrite Cloud Function that atomically deletes all residents, households, and resets village_settings to initial state. Function verifies caller has System Administrator permission.
Successful wipe clears all Pinia stores, sets isFirstRun to true, and redirects to setup wizard.
Sample data includes realistic Zambian names, dates spanning reasonable ranges, and proper household-resident relationships. Data should feel authentic for demonstration purposes.

constraints.constraint: All Vue components MUST use script setup syntax only. Never use export default with Options API.
Use useErrorHandler composable for all error notifications and form validation.
Use existing Pinia store actions (createResident, createHousehold, updateSettings) for client-side seeding to maintain consistency.
Wipe cloud function MUST verify caller has System Administrator permission server-side. Do not trust client-side permission checks for destructive operations.
Components: PascalCase (SetupWizard.vue, SampleDataBanner.vue). Composables: camelCase with use prefix (useSampleData.js).
Sample data must use realistic Zambian names (Banda, Phiri, Mwale, Tembo, Zulu, Mulenga) and Eastern Province context.
Banner must be non-dismissible and persist across all authenticated pages when isUsingSampleData is true.
"Start Fresh with Real Data" option must be disabled with "Coming in future update" note (deferred to Epic 5).
Setup wizard route /setup should not require authentication - wizard handles its own flow.
When isFirstRun is true, user must be redirected to /setup and cannot bypass to other routes.

tests.standards: Tests follow patterns established in docs/testing.md. Unit tests verify individual functions and store actions. Integration tests verify component interactions. Manual testing checklist covers complete user flows. All tests should verify both success and error paths. Permission checks require testing with different user roles (System Administrator vs other roles).
